UK Police Officers Investigated Over Handling of Teenager's Death

Two police officers in Hampshire, UK, are under investigation for gross misconduct concerning their response to Henry Nowak, an 18-year-old who died in December 2025. The Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) is examining whether race was a factor in the officers' initial treatment of Nowak, whom they handcuffed and treated as a suspect. The investigation follows the death of Nowak, who was reportedly stabbed by Vickrum Digwa.
